'''BigHaul Robo-Haulers''' were 1.6-meter long [[Droid/Legends|droid]] vehicles manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] to carry two [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of cargo.
